material_structures.description: A list of extracted material structures.

composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave empty.

lattice_parameter.description: Lattice parameters with units, preserving the exact format from the text (e.g., a=5.191, b=5.239, c=5.392; a=b=c=4.05). Leave empty if not mentioned.

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c). Do NOT leave empty.

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned.

note.description: Additional important structural information not covered by other fields (e.g., m-ZrO2, high-pressure phase, metastable phase). Leave empty if not mentioned.

cutoff_energy.description: Plane wave cutoff energy with units (e.g., 800.0 eV, 520 eV, 400 Ry, 30 Ry). Leave empty if not mentioned.

K_points.description: K-point mesh or sampling scheme (e.g., "6×6×6", "4×4×4", "Monkhorst-Pack 6×6×6", "Gamma-centered 4×4×4"). Leave empty if not mentioned.

pseudo_potential.description: Pseudopotential type or name (e.g., PAW, USPP, norm-conserving pseudopotentials). Leave empty if not mentioned.

Exchange_Correlation_Functional.description: Exchange-correlation functional name (e.g., PBE, LDA, HSE06, PBE+U). Leave empty if not mentioned.

EDIFFG.description: Energy convergence criterion for geometry optimization (e.g., 0.01 eV/Å). Leave empty if not mentioned.

EDIFF.description: Energy convergence criterion for electronic self-consistency (e.g., 1.0×10⁻⁶ eV). Leave empty if not mentioned.

Hubbard_U_value.description: Hubbard U parameter values if DFT+U is used (e.g., U=4.0 eV for Fe). Leave empty if not mentioned.

software.description: Computational software package name (e.g., VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, CASTEP). Leave empty if not mentioned.

theoretical_calculation_method.description: The theoretical method used (e.g., DFT, DFT+U, hybrid DFT). Do NOT leave empty.
